raw_html: [[Fortification|Fortification +100%]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Fortification|Fortification +100%]]:''' This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer much more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a 100% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally.
